Paul Gough has helped 700+ Physical Therapists escape a life of 9-5 stuck inside the treatment room. He is a multi best selling author and when you subscribe to the channel - you can request your 100% free copy The New Patient Accelerator Method marketing book for Physical Therapists. 

As well as a six time best selling author, he is also a former professional soccer physical therapist turned successful clinic owner from the UK (a country where healthcare is free).

He is the founder of the Paul Gough Physio Rooms – a successful cash pay clinic he started from a spare room in his home with no money down and with no business or marketing skills.

He has since scaled his clinic from one to four locations, and zero to $1 million in cash pay revenue, and now helps clinic owners all across America and around the world to get more cash pay patients using his proven systems.
